name: Zettai Shougeki ~Platonic Heart~
original_name: 絶対衝激 ～プラトニックハート～
source:
The story centers on the Platonic Heart, a jewel that—according to an old urban legend—can grant any wish when collected. Only a chosen few are allowed to compete in the Platonic Heart hunt.

The protagonist is Natsume Honma, who throws herself into the Platonic Heart combat after discovering that her best friend Aya has also been selected as one of the Maidens.
translation:
故事围绕白金之心展开。这颗宝石据古老都市传说，集齐后可以实现任何愿望。只有少数被选中的人获准参加白金之心的争夺。

主人公本间夏目发现好友绫也被选为巫女后，投身白金之心的战斗。
